name: MRI Slice Sweep
desc: An axial MRI study scrolling head-first through a procedural cranial volume: dark cortical skull, a bright scalp rind, a thin CSF moat, a folded grey-matter ribbon over brighter white matter, and the lateral ventricles opening into a central butterfly as the scan plane travels endlessly up and down the head, windowed as T1, T2, FLAIR or a false-colour BOLD fMRI activation map.

energy.doc: window contrast / signal gain — brightness of the tissue map

scale.doc: magnification into the slice — zoom the field of view

speed.doc: scan-plane travel rate through the volume (0.15 still sweeps)

density.doc: background acquisition noise / graininess of air

thick.doc: cortical ribbon thickness — thin gyri vs bulky grey mantle

grain.doc: Rician MR noise texture over the image

hue.doc: faint clinical tint on the greyscale (steel blue by default)

x.doc: pan across the slice when magnified

y.doc: pan up/down the slice when magnified

style.doc: MR window: T1 (white bright, CSF black) / T2 (CSF blazing) / FLAIR (CSF nulled, lesions hot) / BOLD false-colour fMRI overlay
